items.description: A multibillion-dollar fuel subsidy that kept Nigerian pump prices low for decades has emerged as a central battleground ahead of January’s presidential elections.

items.description: H.I.G. Capital is exploring options for its controlling stake in US-based Rising Pharmaceuticals, including a possible sale, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Chinese Banks Extend Record-Breaking Rally on Earnings, Dividend
items.description: Chinese bank stocks extended their record-breaking rally, with investors drawn by the sector’s resilient earnings and higher dividends from some of the country’s largest lenders.

items.title: Two Oil Supertankers Hit by Projectiles in Hormuz, Marisks Says
items.description: Two oil supertankers were struck by unknown projectiles in quick succession while transiting the Persian Gulf’s Strait of Hormuz chokepoint, maritime security consultant Marisks said.

items.description: Asian spot liquefied natural gas hit a five-month high on concern that disruptions to flows in the Strait of Hormuz would drag on.
